title: Little Boy Sitting on Lawn, 1949 Suburban B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Making faces at his 'dad' Mar 1949 3 yrs old C793
description: A candid black and white snapshot photo taken in March 1949 featuring a three-year-old boy sitting on the grass in front of a suburban brick house. He wears a warm hooded coat and pants while looking up toward the camera, making a playful expression at his father who is photographing him. The image reflects post-World War II American domestic life and suburban growth during the late 1940s.
